summary.text: Edward Lee is the Republican candidate for Assembly District 36. He describes himself as a longtime independent political activist who has organized cross-partisan candidate forums and debates in New York City.

paragraphs.text: Lee says he has been a political activist for over 30 years and, in 2022, 2024, and 2026, gathered candidates across party lines at a project he founded (unifiedplatformusa.com) to document areas of agreement among them.
He says he has organized what he describes as New York City's only third-party and independent candidate debates.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as activist. He is the Republican candidate in 2026; the Republican primary was canceled and he advanced without appearing on the ballot.
